title: Botanical Illustration at Denver
content: I'm at the Denver Botanic Gardens today, doing a workshop on water-soluble colored pencils.The Denver Botanic Gardens one of America's most extensive botanic gardens. The garden headquarters, which are currently being extensively renovated, also hosts a certificate program for botanical art and illustration.Students who enroll in the program get a chance to study watercolor, pen-and-ink, scratchboard, colored pencil, and other techniques, as well as botanical science.  For more information, visit the page on the DBG site,link., or the Botanical Illustration Blog,link.The picture above is from Dinotopia: A Land Apart from Time. It's painted in oil on illustration board. The pencil drawing was sealed first with acrylic matte medium.
